reader.requirement: A report file's file control entry admits the clauses of the Sequential I-O module's file control entry at the level this implementation supports (level 2: SELECT [OPTIONAL], ASSIGN, RESERVE, [ORGANIZATION IS] SEQUENTIAL, PADDING CHARACTER, RECORD DELIMITER, ACCESS MODE IS SEQUENTIAL, FILE STATUS, in any order after SELECT), and nothing the Sequential I-O module does not print (indexed/relative organization, keys, RANDOM/DYNAMIC access, later editions' LOCK MODE/SHARING). The witness covers only ACCESS MODE and FILE STATUS on a non-report file.

edition-consulted.switches: file.Padding.InEdition = Edition.DialectLevel < 2014: PADDING CHARACTER counts as a Format 3 (sequential) clause below 2014
LOCK MODE / SHARING gated to their introducing edition (refused at 85)

reader.edition-search: grep DialectLevel/InEdition in FileControlBinder.cs and FileControlKeyRules.cs; the ACCESS MODE SR2 screen and the Format-1/2 entry rules are edition-invariant (same arm), which matches the 1985 Sequential I-O format.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: at 85 PADDING CHARACTER is accepted (deleted from 2014) and LOCK MODE/SHARING are refused; the rest is the same arm.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness has no report file; OPTIONAL, RESERVE, PADDING, RECORD DELIMITER on a report file and the refusal of indexed/relative/random forms are not exercised

probes.printed: exit 0; OPEN FS=05, CLOSE FS=00; FC1.TXT = 'HELLO' line; one COBOL1778 warning (RECORD DELIMITER accepted inert)
probes.expected: every level-2 Sequential I-O clause, in any order after SELECT, accepted for a report file; OPEN EXTEND of an absent OPTIONAL file succeeds

probes.printed: COBOL2604: the REPORT clause is not a clause of Format 2 (relative-or-indexed); plus COBOL1837, COBOL2714
probes.expected: refused: a report file has sequential organization (XIII.2.3.4 GR4)

probes.printed: COBOL1858: ACCESS MODE IS RANDOM may not be specified for a sequential file
probes.expected: refused: only ACCESS MODE IS SEQUENTIAL is in the format
refused: LOCK MODE is not a 1985 clause (diagnostic is a bare parse error, but the program is refused)

citations.check: OK  §1985:XIII.2.3.3 SR4  (2.3.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR4

reader.notes: The rule is a pointer to the Sequential I-O module; the implementation provides level 2 and accepts every level-2 clause on a report file, in any order, and refuses the keyed/random forms and later-edition clauses. The only edition arms are PADDING CHARACTER (in edition below 2014) and the LOCK MODE/SHARING introduction gates, both correct for 1985. Diagnostics at 85 cite 2023 clause numbers, which is cosmetic.

refuter.evidence: Read XIII.2.3.2 format, SR1-SR4, GR4 and VII.2.3.2-2.6 (the Sequential I-O format the rule points to). Probes at --std 85 (refute-1985-074): p1_bare (bare SEQUENTIAL, STATUS without FILE, ACCESS without MODE IS, PADDING CHARACTER data-name, RESERVE 1 AREA, ASSIGN without TO, SELECT first and others in mixed order) exit 0, OPEN FS=00 CLOSE FS=00; p1_lineseq (ORGANIZATION LINE SEQUENTIAL on a report file) COBOL0900 refused; p1_relkey (RELATIVE KEY on a report file) COBOL0863 + COBOL0900 refused; p1_nostat (FILE STATUS PIC 99) COBOL2455 refused per VII.2.5.3 SR2. cite.py: OK §1985:XIII.2.3.3 SR4 'the text is in SR4'; OK §1985:VII.2.5.3 SR2 'the text is in SR2'.
